title: Benchmark Report (Latency/$) — Risk Log / Register
content:
Doc purpose
- Track launch-critical risks for the public benchmark report (Latency/$) and interactive web experience.
- Keep mitigations + owners crisp; update weekly during build, daily during launch week.
- This is a working log (Drive). Source-of-truth for methodology/claims remains Confluence + Legal threads.

Scale / definitions
- Likelihood: Low / Med / High
- Impact: Low / Med / High
- Status: Open / Monitoring / Mitigated / Closed

RISK REGISTER (last updated: 2025-07-17)

| ID | Category | Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Trigger / early warning | Mitigation / response | Owner | Backup | Status | Notes / last update | Next check |
|---|----------|------|------------|--------|------------------------|-----------------------|-------|--------|--------|---------------------|------------|
| R-01 | Data quality | Latency/$ numbers unstable across repeated runs (variance too high), undermining credibility | Med | High | p95 swings > threshold between reruns; outlier clusters by region/time-of-day | Stability gates + auto-rerun; lock runner versions; publish confidence notes; exclude runs failing gates | Jonas Weber | Rina Kobayashi | Monitoring | Implemented rerun-on-variance (ENG-18521). Still seeing some eu-west variability during peak | Weekly until republish window closes |
| R-02 | Methodology | Accusations of cherry-picking workload (prefill/decode mix) or prompt set not representative | Med | High | External comments/questions asking “does this match real workloads?” | Publish methodology + prompt set rationale; include multiple workload profiles; add “how to map to your workload” section in FAQ | Claire Dubois | Elliot Price | Monitoring | Added prompt set v3 “production mix” rationale; Sales asking for a 30s explanation | Before webinar + 1 week after launch |
| R-03 | Infra/capacity | Region capacity constraints prevent completing region sweeps on schedule | Med | High | Reservation failures; spot interruptions; long queue times on runners | Reserve capacity in advance; define fallback regions; schedule off-peak; keep “missing region” policy | Vanessa Ortiz | Harish Reddy | Monitoring | APAC instance type constraint noted; have fallback plan (publish subset + clearly label) | Twice weekly through end of sweeps |
| R-04 | Infra/capacity | Launch-week traffic impacts production fleet or benchmark JSON service reliability | Med | High | Spikes in 5xx, 429s, CDN errors; cache miss storm | Separate caching layer; rate-limit page API; pre-warm CDN; SRE on-call coverage during launch | Sean Gallagher | Felix Schneider | Mitigated | Incident during launch: cache miss storm causing page latency; CDN config updated + prewarm added | Daily during launch week; then weekly |
| R-05 | Legal/claims | Comparative claims not substantiated or phrased too strongly (“fastest”, “best”, “beats X”) | Med | High | Legal redlines; partner/press asks for definitive winner language | Use approved message house; “in our tests” framing; include disclaimers; require Legal signoff for any competitor mention | Michael Grant | Sofia Mendes | Monitoring | Legal removed a “#1 latency/$” headline candidate; replacing with “leading efficiency in measured configs” | Prior to any copy freeze |
| R-06 | Legal/claims | Inconsistent claims across assets (blog vs PDF vs landing page vs sales deck) | Med | Med | Sales uses older slide; last-minute edits not propagated | Single source claim sheet; final approval gate; central “copy lock” date; disable outdated decks | Soojin Lee | Stephanie Nguyen | Monitoring | Internal deck had an older p95 figure; updated on 7/10; Sales notified | Weekly + pre-launch day |
| R-07 | Security/compliance | Public artifacts leak sensitive operational details (runner IDs, internal hostnames, customer IDs, capacity signals) | Low | High | Security review flags; community spots internal identifiers in CSV/JSON | Redaction pipeline; manual review checklist step; limit granularity where needed | Naomi Feldman | Mei Lin | Mitigated | PR-4873 redaction landed; security sign-off contingent on spot-check of v1 artifacts | Before each publish/refresh |
| R-08 | Data governance | Inability to reproduce/defend numbers later (missing raw logs/configs/manifests) | Low | High | A press/analyst request asks for proof; internal audit can’t locate artifacts | Data retention policy; store manifests + raw logs with access controls; publish artifact version hashes | Nadia Rahman | Mei Lin | Monitoring | Retention policy drafted; need to confirm storage location + permissions for Legal access | Monthly |
| R-09 | Measurement | Latency/$ metric misunderstood (people interpret as “dollars per token” or confuse with throughput) | High | Med | Repeated inbound questions; social posts misquote metric | Add tooltip + FAQ; include supporting metrics (p50/p95, $/1M tokens, tok/sec) | Wei Chen | Renee Sullivan | Monitoring | Marketing wants simpler label; keeping “Latency/$ (lower is better)” with tooltip + explainer | Daily during launch week |
| R-10 | Product/market | Prospects assume results apply to all prompts/context lengths; disappointment in PoC | Med | High | “We didn’t see those numbers” in support/sales calls | Provide replication guide; workload mapping; recommend PoC steps; clarify caching/batching settings | Markus Klein | Lukas Meyer | Monitoring | SEs requesting “how to replicate” doc for outbound; assembling short checklist + caveats | Weekly until pipeline stabilizes |
| R-11 | Web/UX | Interactive table confusing: filters hide caveats; users screenshot without context | Med | Med | Screenshots on social omit disclaimers; users miss ‘measured config’ details | Sticky disclaimer; per-row “config details” drawer; watermark on exports; include methodology link on export | Alicia Perez | Felix Schneider | Monitoring | Export CSV includes header disclaimers; considering adding “generated_at + methodology_version” columns | After first 2 weeks of feedback |
| R-12 | Data selection | Model/region list changes late (new model release or region GA) causing rework or perceived omission | Med | Med | Product announces new model; internal debate “why isn’t X included?” | Define cut-off date; publish “what’s included” and “refresh cadence”; optionally add addendum post | Henry Cho | Nikhil Sharma | Monitoring | Discussion on whether to patch v1 for new model; leaning addendum rather than republishing PDF | Weekly post-launch |
| R-13 | Comms | External critique on fairness (competitor baselines, hardware parity) becomes loud and damages brand | Low | High | Community thread questioning methodology; press asks for rebuttal | Prepare canonical response; link methodology; avoid arguing specifics; offer to share harness configs | Ethan Wallace | Soojin Lee | Monitoring | Drafted response language in marketing thread; add to public FAQ if repeats | Daily during first week post-launch |
| R-14 | Ops/attribution | KPI tracking breaks: events not firing; HubSpot campaign tagging inconsistent → can’t measure pipeline impact | Med | Med | Dashboard gaps; “unknown source”; CTA clicks not attributed | Implement analytics events; QA in staging; define naming conventions; retroactively backfill if needed | Tyler Benson | Logan Wright | Monitoring | Events for filters + export + CTA shipped; need to validate HubSpot tagging for webinar leads | Weekly for first month |
| R-15 | Support load | Spike in inbound tickets about benchmark numbers/regions overwhelms Support | Med | Med | Ticket volume up; repeated same questions | Publish canonical FAQ; macros for Support; route complex questions to SE office hours | Jasmine Liu | Markus Klein | Monitoring | Support flagged caching/batching question repeats; macro created linking methodology + explanation | Twice weekly |
| R-16 | Editorial | Review cycle slip (Legal/Eng/Security) pushes dates; launch misses window | Med | High | Redlines late; stakeholders unavailable; “one more sweep” requests | Freeze dates; enforce ‘must fix vs nice to have’; pre-schedule exec/Legal review blocks | Talia Benson | Soojin Lee | Monitoring | Resolved for v1 but risk remains for v1.1 PDF edits; keep a tight patch scope | For any refresh/change |
| R-17 | Reliability | Benchmark runner/tooling regressions mid-sweep change results (non-comparable runs) | Low | High | Runner version mismatch; different kernel selection; dependency drift | Dockerized runner pinned; manifest includes version hash; block merges during sweeps | Rina Kobayashi | Noah Patel | Mitigated | Docker runner (PR-4888) used for final sweeps; manifests capture commit SHA | Before any rerun window |
| R-18 | Regional policy | Data residency / “EU coverage” language misinterpreted as compliance guarantee | Med | High | EMEA prospect asks “does this mean GDPR/ residency by default?” | Tight language: region availability ≠ compliance; route to security/compliance docs; add EMEA talk track | Lukas Meyer | Sofia Mendes | Monitoring | EMEA asked to highlight eu-west only; add explicit note: residency depends on deployment mode/config | Before EMEA campaign sends |

Open questions / TODO (keep short)
- Confirm where the final immutable artifact bundle is stored (raw logs + derived dataset + PDF hash) and who has access (Legal + Security + Applied ML). (Owner: Mei Lin)
- Decide refresh policy: what constitutes “material change” requiring PDF republish vs addendum blog. (Owner: Henry Cho + Soojin Lee)
- Add 1-page “replication quickstart for PoCs” (non-public, Sales/SE) referencing the same workloads/configs. (Owner: Markus Klein)

Decision log (selected)
- 2025-06-24: Legal required removal/softening of “best/fastest” superlatives; all comparative language must be ‘in our tests’ + include caveats. (Michael Grant)
- 2025-07-09: Launch assets copy-locked; only typo-level changes allowed unless Legal/PMM approve. (Soojin Lee)
- 2025-07-11: Post-launch web incident response: prewarm + CDN config changes; keep rate-limits conservative to protect JSON service. (Sean Gallagher)

Update cadence
- Weekly during build; daily during launch week; weekly for 4 weeks post-launch, then close out or roll into refresh planning.
